protocol.format: shape keys are batch x heads x KV tokens; configs: default=[head_tile,splits], dense=[head_tile,key_tile,splits], triton=[head_tile,key_tile,warps,splits]
protocol.input: contiguous FP16, one KV head, latent dimension512, positional dimension64; GPU torch.randn for final measurement
protocol.summary: median of six batch-average full-call wall samples
protocol.boundary: output/workspace allocations, all kernel launches, merge, batch-end synchronization; compilation and search excluded
protocol.order: all six permutations of the three implementations
protocol.tuning: C500 default; dense and Triton configurations were screened on the earlier f549117c stack and replayed on dev 90d49f35 without retuning. This is a fixed-configuration comparison, not a current-compiler optimum claim.
